text:
alex: Final countdown for Marketplace listing with CloudGroove + EdgeBox SI tomorrow. Need go/no-go on press timing, hero assets, and SI runbook.

tara: Press embargo set for 11:00 PT. CloudGroove wants the hero and badge to go live at same second as the blog.

diego: Ops: staging-1 has a maintenance window at 11:05 PT that might clash with our CDN purge. We should avoid heavy edge work at flip.

sophia: Could we pre-stage everything behind a feature flag and flip at 11:00 PT? That avoids deploy-time contention.

ops_bot: feature-flag toggle available. ops requires final S3 path, UTM strings, and a preview window request.

alex: Partner will upload assets to s3://marketplace/cloudgroove/edgebox/hero-final/ by 07:00 PT. Confirmed promo code EDGEBOX25 and utm_source=cloudgroove&utm_campaign=marketplace_q2.

tara: Legal: need partner crediting short line. Diego, can you add the legal-approved snippet to the landing meta before flip?

diego: yes. I'll patch meta and ops will preview. Ops, schedule preview at 09:30 PT and a dry-run flip at 10:50 PT internally (no public exposure).

ops_bot: calendar entries created: preview 09:30 PT (staging-1), dry-run 10:50 PT, embargo flip 11:00 PT. Post-launch checks at 11:10 PT and 11:20 PT.

sophia: SI checklist reminder: EdgeBox needs egress whitelist and OAuth token exchange verified. After flip ops should run: `curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://edgebox.si.internal/health | jq -r .status` expecting "ok".

partner-ops: assets uploaded: hero-final (07:02 PT). sitemap + partner badge attached.

alex: Great. Ops, avoid CDN purge during 11:00-11:06 PT due to maintenance. Instead purge edges at 11:12 PT.

diego: noted. We'll flip feature flag at 11:00 PT, run smoke tests at 11:02 PT, queue CDN purge at 11:12 PT.

tara: Marketing will trigger blog publish on embargo lift and watch for analytics events. Confirm final UTM and coupon in assets doc?

partner-ops: confirmed utm_source=cloudgroove&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=marketplace_q2 and coupon=EDGEBOX25 added to metadata.

sophia: I'll run SI token test at 11:03 PT and post results. If token exchange fails we'll rollback flag within 3 minutes.

ops_bot: reminder set for rollback window: 3m. Post-launch verification checklist attached to calendar event.

alex: Owners: assets=partner-ops, ops=diego, press=tara, SI=sophia. 1-line runbook copied below for clarity:
``
- 07:00 PT: partner asset upload complete
- 09:30 PT: ops visual preview on staging-1 (feature-flag preview)
- 10:50 PT: ops dry-run (internal)
- 11:00 PT: embargo lift -> flip feature flag -> publish blog
- 11:02 PT: smoke tests (landing, analytics, SI health)
- 11:12 PT: CDN purge (edges)
- 11:20 PT: final verification & close
```

tara: I'll be watching press channel and will only confirm flip once legal copy is in landing meta.

partner-ops: partner pushed a minor mobile crop update at 08:40 PT. Preview link: https://staging-1.redwood.ai/cloudgroove/edgebox/preview

diego: preview looks good, mobile crop fixed. Ops standing by in #release-war-room at 09:30 PT.

sophia: SI health check green at 11:03 PT in dry-run. Will re-run at live flip.

alex: Good work team. We'll only abort if SI health fails or analytics events don't fire. Otherwise proceed. :rocket:
